title: Just, Already & Yet
objectives: Use just, already & yet accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use just, already, and yet in present perfect contexts.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about just, already & yet. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use just, already & yet?
Can you think of one example?

explanation: Just = very recent | Already = before expected | Yet = until now (?/−)

grammar.title: Just, Already & Yet
grammar.rule: Just = very recent | Already = before expected | Yet = until now (?/−)

examples.sentence: I have just sent the email.

vocabulary.example: I have just sent the email.

sentences: I have just sent the email.

reading.title: Just, Already & Yet in Context
reading.text: I have just finished the report. She has already told the manager. We haven't decided yet. Have they arrived yet? — Yes, they have just arrived.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using just, already & yet. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: I have just sent the email. They have already left. Have you replied yet? Recent changes.
